name: wcway
description: Find the nearest public toilet worldwide with the wcway MCP server.

interface.longDescription: wcway finds public toilets worldwide. It shows distance, walk time, access rule, fee, opening state and wheelchair access. The MCP server is public and needs no key. Toilet data is © OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL).
